results.question: does High Dividend Stocks fund have performance fees?
results.answer:
Yes, the High Dividend Stocks Fund has performance fees.

The performance fee structure is as follows:
1. **Performance Fee Calculation** : 15% of profit (High-on-high principle) .
2. **High Watermark Condition** : Performance fee will only be charged if at the end of the financial year the NAV (before deduction of performance fee and relevant distributions) exceeds the “high watermark,” which is the all-time year-end high of the Fund’s NAV for the accumulation classes (and dividend adjusted equivalent for distribution paying classes). If in any one year, the Fund suffers a loss, no performance fee can be charged in subsequent years until the loss is recovered fully .

Please note that this information is subject to change, and investors should refer to the latest offering document for detailed fee structures and terms. (From Feishu Knowledge AI | https://ask.feishu.cn)

results.question: what is the performance fee for High Dividend stocks fund?
results.answer:
The performance fee for the High Dividend Stocks Fund is as follows:

1. **Performance fee calculation principle** : The performance fee will only be charged if at the end of the financial year the NAV (before deduction of performance fee and relevant distributions) exceeds the “high watermark,” which is the all-time year-end high of the Fund’s NAV for the accumulation classes (and dividend adjusted equivalent for distribution paying classes). If in any one year, the Fund suffers a loss, no performance fee can be charged in subsequent years until the loss is recovered fully (the high-on-high principle).
2. **Performance fee rate** : The performance fee rate is 15% of the profit.

It should be noted that different share classes may have the same performance fee calculation method, but please refer to the official documents for the most accurate information. (From Feishu Knowledge AI | https://ask.feishu.cn)
